messages:
anita: heads up — after yesterday's RBAC role/perm refactor I see a weird gap when keys are KMS-wrapped + rotated. rotated key still allows calls to /v1/chat even though the token is scoped to embeddings only.

mike: can you paste an example request + audit log line?

anita: minimal request header and audit snippet below (staging):
```
POST /v1/chat/completions
Authorization: Bearer sk-stg-xxxx
X-Route-Alias: embeddings/us-east
Body: {"messages":[...] }
```
Audit event: `{timestamp:1680000000, principal: "svc-team-x", action: "chat.completions.create", api_key_id: null, key_alias: "projects/prod/key-1234", allowed_scopes: ["embeddings.create"]}`

anita: note api_key_id is null, key_alias is set to the KMS resource, and action is chat.completions.create even though allowed_scopes only had embeddings.create.

sec-bot: alert triggered — potential scope enforcement mismatch on KMS-wrapped keys (severity: medium).

samir: interesting — sounds like two possible failures: (1) token introspection isn't resolving key_id when key material is KMS-wrapped -> fallback path that doesn't check per-route scopes, (2) route alias translation (X-Route-Alias) might be mapping embeddings alias to a compatible chat handler, and RBAC check uses the resolved handler instead of original requested route.

mike: I can repro locally if someone gives me the exact rotation job id and the KMS envelope details used in staging.

anita: rotation job: rotate-job-2026-03-18-7, KMS envelope: projects/prod/keys/key-1234/cryptoKeyVersion/3. I can share logs in vault.

jordan: assigning to samir to triage. can we treat this as a P1 until we confirm blast radius? cc @oncall

samir: taking it. immediate mitigation steps: 1) disable KMS-wrapped key fallback that returns api_key_id=null 2) add guard to reject requests when allowed_scopes doesn't include the final action 3) short-term: block route-alias translations that map embeddings->chat.

mike: adding quick unit + integration tests: introspection should return api_key_id and scopes for wrapped keys. also add one end-to-end that hits staging with rotated key and asserts 403 for chat.

anita: on the audit side we need key_id added to logs and the original requested_route logged (not post-translation handler). current missing fields are why we couldn't detect this earlier.

samir: agreed. I'll push a small patch to the introspection service to always include a resolved_key_id and to validate scopes against the incoming route before alias translation.

jordan: created INF-4321 in tracker, linked to staging run + audit sample: https://tracker.internal/INF-4321 :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: deploy queued: introspect-service/patch-2026-03-20-01 -> staging at 15:20 UTC.

anita: after deploy, I'll run the rotated-key test and share results here. if green we'll schedule hotfix to prod.

mike: also adding a regression test in CI: when KMS envelope used, introspection must return api_key_id != null and scopes must be authoritative.

samir: postmortem checklist starters: timeline, root cause (introspection fallback + alias translation ordering), missing audit fields, short-term mitigations, code-level fixes, and follow-ups (CI guards, e2e with KMS-wrapped keys, KMS audit mapping).

anita: thanks — ping me if you need vault access for the envelope.

jordan: I'll draft a short incident note for the compliance team with the audit snippet and remediation plan.

sec-bot: monitoring: added temporary alert rule to watch api_key_id == null + high-privilege actions for 24h.

anita: update: staging repro failed initially, then succeeded after I toggled the rotation job debug flag. suspect caching. saving log: `introspect:cache_hit:true key_alias:projects/prod/keys/key-1234 api_key_id:NULL`

samir: that cache_hit with api_key_id null is the smoking gun. cache population path must be using envelope metadata but not resolving key mapping during rotation. will invalidate caches on rotation event and add stronger invariants.

mike: ok will add cache invalidation and tests. plan looks solid. thanks all.

anita: filing follow-up to expand audit schema to include kms_key_version and original_route.

jordan: moving INF-4321 to in-progress. will update compliance once prod fix is scheduled.
